decisions.rationale: Draft contract for durable source and existing graph return paths. This PR records the planning request through existing helpers and retained data; no production source change or new publication authority.
Proposed inventory and partial-coverage contract only. Runtime denominator and mapping enforcement are deferred; the seven draft obligations do not claim new canonical behavior.
Proposed scoped authoring-profile obligation only. Current compiler capabilities and optional relations are documented; no new checker, ontology schema or runtime profile is activated.
Proposed distinction between declarations, checking methods and execution. Existing native BDD boundaries are reused in the design; scenario execution adapters are not implemented here.
Proposed provenance, denominator and complexity interpretation contract. SIB proxies, scoring code and thresholds are unchanged; incomplete inputs remain a documented future concern.
Proposed use of existing SG-SPEC-0015 and SG-SPEC-0049 for large leaves and bounded refinement. Numeric atomicity gates and canonical specs are not changed in this PR.
Planned SG-SPEC-0072 sensitivity experiment only. A frozen unmerged source revision and pending next action are recorded; no behavioral pilot or readiness activation is claimed.
